scope: Opening through early journey, breakfast/local-food stop, journey progression, tea/urgency, first hill/destination approach.
sourceOfTruth: Evidence from bundle 001 as previously reviewed and the corresponding exact range decisions persisted in edit_timeline.json.
editorialObjective: Establish the premise quickly, preserve the natural breakfast problem and local moments, accelerate the journey, and build anticipation toward the hill/adventure payoff.

storyBeats.detail: Creator introduces the trip, temple-in-the-hill premise and an off-road promise. The first seconds before useful setup are weak and should be removed.
Journey starts with distance/traffic context and an intention to stop for breakfast.
Breakfast search becomes a natural small problem/stop rather than a generic restaurant insertion.
Breakfast plan fails/changes, creating room for a local food/thali discovery and a more authentic journey.
Village/single-lane-road travel and changing scenery provide progression toward the destination.
Bike/tea/local interactions provide human texture and prevent the journey from becoming only road footage.
Realization that it is already late creates a reason to stop meandering and push toward the destination.
Hill/landscape footage starts transitioning the story from travel toward the destination/adventure payoff.

crossBundleEditorialNotes.bestNarrativeMaterial: Problem/food pivot, tea/late realization, and destination approach are more editorially valuable than raw driving minutes.
